headline: The program's single biggest exposure is Reporting data lineage mapping (Data): it is 45% complete and behind pace on the critical path, with 15 downstream tasks across 6 teams queued behind it.

risks.why_it_matters: Data lineage mapping is behind pace at the front of the critical path. The extract fixes, the calculation rewrite and the parallel run all queue behind it, and the regulator deadline does not move.
risks.mitigation: Scope lineage to the fields in the audit findings first. Y. Tanaka can hand those to Engineering this week and finish the long tail in parallel.

risks.why_it_matters: The control gap assessment is behind pace, and Compliance owns it while also owning control testing, the evidence pack and the attestation. It has float today; the risk is that the same people are needed everywhere at once.
risks.mitigation: Borrow one reviewer from internal audit for the gap assessment so F. Moreau is free for control testing when the harness lands.

risks.why_it_matters: The evidence repository is blocked on a retention policy that has not been written yet. It has room on the calendar, but an evidence pack with nowhere to live is not an evidence pack.
risks.mitigation: Stand the repository up under the current retention policy now and migrate it when the rewrite lands, rather than waiting on R06.

cascade_summary: If Reporting data lineage mapping slips 3 more days, the program end date moves from day 53 to day 56, a 3-day hit that lands on Compliance, Data, Design, Engineering, Marketing and Ops.

R13.why_it_matters: The calculation rewrite is the longest build task on the critical path and waits on both extract fixes and data quality controls.
R13.mitigation: Have V. Mensah start on the calculations with the cleanest source extracts while the rest of the fixes land.

R20.why_it_matters: Every workstream converges here: variance sign-off, control testing and the evidence repository. It is the single point where a slip anywhere upstream becomes a slip in the submission.
R20.mitigation: Assemble the evidence pack incrementally as each workstream finishes, instead of in one push at the end.
